name: vatnode
label: vatnode
description: vatnode validates EU VAT numbers against the official VIES register, monitors them for changes and returns EU VAT rates.

modules.name: validate-vat
modules.label: Validate a VAT Number
modules.description: Validates an EU VAT number against the official VIES register and returns the trader name, address and the VIES consultation number.

modules.name: monitor-vat
modules.label: Monitor a VAT Number
modules.description: Adds an EU VAT number to daily monitoring so changes in VIES raise an event.

modules.name: get-vat-rates
modules.label: Get VAT Rates
modules.description: Returns the current standard, reduced, super-reduced and parking VAT rates for a European country.

modules.name: watch-vat-events
modules.label: Watch VAT Events
modules.description: Triggers when a monitored EU VAT number stops being valid, becomes valid again, or the trader name or address changes in VIES.

modules.name: make-api-call
modules.label: Make an API Call
modules.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized call to the vatnode API.
